strings.string: You finished the return-to-run program. Keep running the last workout, or start again at workout 1.
It is recommended that you run no more than once per day.
It is recommended that you run no more than six times per week.
Press Start to open the link on your phone.

40 workouts of running and walking.|Each starts with a 5-minute warm-up walk and ends with a 5-minute cool-down walk.|A 1-minute walk comes before the cool-down, except #38 to #40.|Run at most once a day, 4 to 6 times a week.|Every run is recorded to Garmin Connect.
#1 R1 W1 ×3 means run 1 min, walk 1 min, 3 times.|R1:30 means run 1:30.|No W: no walk.|No ×: once.|Below it: total time, warm-up and cool-down included.|* marks the recommended workout.
Rate each run when it ends. Your next workout:|Bad: back one|OK: same one|Good: next one|Great: skip one|Never below #1 or past #40.
Full days between your last run and today move you back after the rating:|0 to 2: no change|3: back one|4: back two|5: back three|6+: restart at #1
Before a run you may be warned:|Once per day: you already ran today.|Six per week: you ran each of the last 6 days.|Continue runs anyway. Cancel goes back.

During a workout:|Start: pause or resume.|Back: pause.|Back while paused: End workout?|Resume: keep going.|Save: save and rate it.|Discard: delete it, not logged.|After the cool-down it ends and asks for a rating.
